hero.filename: Cowichan Valley Railway diesel locomotive 23 (Sandy) Plymouth 8-ton DLC6 at Forest Museum Duncan BC 16-Jul-1995.jpg
hero.caption: Cowichan Valley Railway locomotive #23 "Sandy" (Plymouth 8-ton DLC6) at BC Forest Museum (now BC Forest Discovery Centre) in Duncan, British Columbia (16-Jul-1995). Built 1924, 36" gauge, powered by Climax "Trustworthy" 90hp gasoline engine.
hero.alt: Cowichan Valley Railway locomotive #23 "Sandy" (Plymouth 8-ton DLC6) at BC Forest Museum (now BC Forest Discovery Centre) in Duncan, British Columbia (16-Jul-1995). Built 1924, 36" gauge, powered by Climax "Trustworthy" 90hp gasoline engine.
